description:
Read anything in Karea without changing it: projects, tasks, subtasks, notes, sticky notes, task documents and AI context, open questions, resources, meetings, reminders, Jira links, AI sessions, and the activity recap. The main entry point - start here.

Pass one of these as `action`, with its arguments in `params`:
- karea_list_projects - List all Karea projects with their IDs [no parameters]
- karea_list_tasks - List tasks in a project. [optional: projectId, status, closedSince, limit, category, priority, assignee, search]
- karea_view_task - Return one task with all its details (status, priority, deadline, recurrence, category, description, notes, requisites, links), located by visual ID, name or UUID. [required: task; optional: projectId, includeContext]
- karea_view_tasks - Return details for MANY tasks in one response. [required: tasks; optional: projectId, includeContext, includeMarkdown]
- karea_list_subtasks - List subtasks of a parent task. [required: parent; optional: projectId]
- karea_list_notes - List the notes (human-readable updates) on a task, newest first. [required: task; optional: projectId]
- karea_list_sticky_notes - List the user's sticky notes - the scratch pad: short reminders, commands, URLs. [optional: projectId]
- karea_get_markdown - Read the markdown document attached to a task. [required: task; optional: projectId]
- karea_get_context - Read the task's Context - titled entries of AI working memory that hold the FULL HISTORY of a task (not just its current state): what was tried, decided, discovered, and abandoned along the way. [required: task; optional: projectId]
- karea_list_questions - List open questions (unresolved decisions or blockers) in a project, newest first. [optional: projectId, status]
- karea_list_resources - List resources (text notes & files). [optional: projectId, query, folder, type, mime, minSize, maxSize]
- karea_get_resource - Return a resource with its full content and metadata, by ID. [required: resourceId]
- karea_list_meetings - List meetings. [optional: scope, from, to, projectId]
- karea_view_meeting - Return one meeting in full: time, location, project, attendees, prep notes, transcript, linked tasks and linked open questions. [required: meetingId]
- karea_check_reminders - Return the caller's upcoming and past-due reminders. [optional: taskId, includeDone]
- karea_get_jira_link - Return the linked JIRA issue (key and URL) for a task, if one exists. [required: task; optional: projectId]
- karea_list_sessions - List AI coding sessions linked to a task (provider, sessionId, label, last active, resume command). [required: task; optional: projectId]
- karea_recap - Return a summary of recent activity (tasks created, closed and updated) over a recent time window. [optional: hours, projectId]

For the full parameter schema of any action, call karea_help with that action name.

action.description: Which operation to perform. See the list in this tool's description.

params.description: Arguments for the chosen action, as an object. Omit for actions that take none.

name: karea_read
title: Read from Karea
